transcript.answer: Otto's conversations started surviving an api restart on 2026-09-30. PR #300, "Persist support conversations through HAL Engine's MongoSessionStore", was merged at 10:25:51 UTC that day (merge commit 529fe7a). Before that, `apps/api/src/server.ts` called `createHalEngine` without a session store, so HAL Engine's in-memory default held every conversation and a restart destroyed them. PR #300 composed the engine with `MongoSessionStore` (HAL Engine 0.4.0), and the PR's own work closed issue #296 the same day. The earlier issue #23, which was about persistence, closed on 2026-09-23. Otto's own wiring only landed with #300.

judgements.reason: The answer gives the same date (2026-09-30) and the same change, composing the engine with HAL Engine 0.4.0's MongoSessionStore in place of the in-memory default; the merge commit it cites can coexist with the gold's commit 3f731c4.
